population: pages of eligible judgments (overlap with H-OUT/H-HOLD allowed), classed from the C11 citation graph and treatment candidates (BODY zone, first-occurrence page), plus pages with no detected citation (to measure misses)
selection: lowest SHA-256(seed|judgment_key#pN) within each court-group x page class

size_justification.note: Coders record every case citation and treatment on each sampled page, so precision and recall are measured on the same units. With about 3 citations per citing page, 140 citing pages give about 400 citation instances; the 50 treatment-cue pages give a per-type precision interval of about +/-7pp at p=0.8 for the common types (APPLIES, CITES); rare types (OVERRULES, DISTINGUISHES) get descriptive counts only.

unit: citing page (representative copy x page); clustered by judgment
